question.q: Which sentence means 'Hardly any students missed the meeting'?
question.correct: Almost all students attended the meeting.
wrong: Almost all students missed the meeting.
No one knew a meeting had been scheduled.
The meeting was canceled before anyone arrived.
question.exp: Hardly any ... missed 等於幾乎沒有人缺席，因此幾乎全部到場。

question.q: Which sentence best matches 'The bridge will not open until the safety inspection is complete'?
question.correct: The bridge will remain closed before the inspection is finished.
wrong: The bridge will open before the inspection begins.
The inspection can only happen after the bridge opens.
The bridge has already been open for months.
question.exp: not ... until 表在檢驗完成前不開放，不能誤解為立即開放。
